entry.title: Market brief — 20 Nov 2026 close
entry.summary: Indian market brief in plain English: Friday 20 November 2026 was the last trading session, with the Nifty 50 closing at 25,800.60 (+286.30, +1.12%) and the Sensex at 83,919.71 (+897.96, +1.08%), and the rupee at 92.67 per dollar. IBJA's 12:00 IST benchmark put 24K gold at ₹1,23,584 per 10 g (-₹6,401) and 999 silver at ₹1,50,650 per kg (-₹10,925). The exchanges are shut on Saturday 21 and Sunday 22 November 2026, so these are Friday's levels, re-checked against two independent sources on Sunday 22 November 2026; the next session is Monday 23 November 2026. Education, not advice.
